the faulting in the HBF and the adjacent Kiawah basin is a result of the interaction of two major plate boundary processes: (1) the northeast-trending maximum horizontal compressional stresses associated with the plate boundary between the North American and Caribbean plates, and (2) the northeast-tending maximum horizontal extensional stresses associated with the Atlantic spreading center.
